necessary_findings.observation: cleanup awaits active_owned() before iterating known_ids. A SandboxList ConnectionError aborts discovery and skips SandboxTerminate/SandboxWait even when the successful create response already supplied sandbox_id. Offline real pinned protobuf trace: create, result JSON read, result ZIP read, list failure, App exit, client close; zero terminate calls.
necessary_findings.consequence: The receipt conservatively stays unresolved and retains USD0.65, but the known owned Sandbox receives no explicit stop attempt. This violates the required known-ID cleanup behavior and can leave it running until its server timeout.
necessary_findings.required_change: Attempt bounded termination/polling of every already observed owned ID regardless of discovery failure. Preserve discovery failure and unresolved status when complete ownership cleanup cannot be proved. Keep the shared cleanup deadline and no paid replay.

necessary_findings.observation: The outer main initializes paid_call_started=False and keeps that receipt if execute_async unexpectedly raises. run_owned_job can raise from its final runtime-receipt write after a paid create and failed cleanup. With an empty official App list, reconcile_stop treats the initial false as evidence of no paid work, synthesizes compute_stopped/resources_verified=True and finish CAS writes failed-stopped.
necessary_findings.consequence: A reservation with a lost/unknown execution receipt can become terminal without identity or stopping evidence, permitting a subsequent reserve. The injected main trace is CAS_reserved -> execute_entered -> CAS_failed-stopped.
necessary_findings.required_change: Once execution is entered, an exception without a complete returned receipt must remain unresolved unless trustworthy persisted progress plus complete stop evidence is recovered. Never infer no paid create from the outer default or an empty inventory.
necessary_findings.probe_boundary: The main-level executor and official inventory are offline fakes. The concrete unexpected-raise path is the unguarded runtime-receipt writer in run_owned_job finally; this probe does not assert any real resource was left active.

necessary_findings.observation: The workflow does not specify artifact retention-days, and cost_proof contains a fixed USD0.21 storage_cleanup reservation without a bounded preservation period, aggregate retained bytes, rate/allowance basis or numeric storage derivation. The contract explicitly requires transfer/preservation-period bounds before each paid dispatch.
necessary_findings.consequence: Compute and egress have numeric proofs, but the claimed full USD0.65 bound is not completely reviewable for saved outputs. This finding does not claim actual overspend or a new named Volume.
necessary_findings.required_change: Freeze an explicit bounded artifact preservation period and a defensible total-output/retention cost calculation or verified allowance basis; state the ephemeral Modal filesystem lifecycle separately. Keep the total single-attempt reservation at USD0.65 or stop before dispatch if the full proof does not fit.
